mapper.select: SELECT sum(${validatedColumnName}) sum,max(${validatedColumnName}) max,min(${validatedColumnName}) min,avg(${validatedColumnName}) avg FROM ${validatedTableName}
SELECT ${validatedColumnName} , count(1) total FROM ${validatedTableName} group by ${validatedColumnName}
SELECT ${validatedXColumnName}, sum(${validatedYColumnName}) total FROM ${validatedTableName} group by ${validatedXColumnName}

select.if: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y-%m-%d') ${validatedXColumnName}, sum(${validatedYColumnName}) total FROM ${validatedTableName} group by DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y-%m') ${validatedXColumnName}, sum(${validatedYColumnName}) total FROM ${validatedTableName} group by DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y-%m')
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y') ${validatedXColumnName}, sum(${validatedYColumnName}) total FROM ${validatedTableName} group by DATE_FORMAT(${validatedXColumnName},'%Y')
